name: Grilled eggs
summary: Eggs are on the town grill list, and the falls page names trứng gà nướng at the tree stalls. Treat them as one egg, and check which bird when you order.
origin: The town piece says trứng. The falls page says trứng gà nướng, with cơm lam, corn, and sweet potato.
howToEat: From the grill. A further method was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The town stalls at hồ Sa Pa and the road down to the market, and the tree stalls at Silver Waterfall.
seoTitle: Grilled eggs in Sapa — town stalls and the falls
seoDescription: Grilled eggs in town, and trứng gà nướng at the Silver Waterfall stalls. A price is Check on arrival.
